# OptiScaler v0.9.4

## 2 fun milestones - OptiScaler has now passed 1 MILLION downloads and over 9000 stars! 🎉 🎉 🎉 
We would like to send our thanks to everyone for the longlasting support!

And now the release info.
This release is focused on adding **proper support for FSR 4.1.1/FFX 2.3 SDK** which adds **INT8 support, albeit officially for RDNA3 only**. Please read the notes below on how...
